articles.title: v2.1.316
articles.author: ashwin-ant
articles.summary: What's changed Added CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRATHINK , which turns the ultrathink keyword off Added pooled group budgets to the Claude apps gateway: one monthly budget that a group's members share, on top of each member's own limit, set with pooled_budget on the spend limits admin API Added CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LOOPED_CROSS_CERT_DROP to keep system cross-certificates that certify each other in a loop, for servers whose private CA needs one Added CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT to set the effort level

articles.title: LocalStack for Azure Enters Public Preview with Security Settings Stored but Not Enforced
articles.author: Steef-Jan Wiggers
articles.summary: LocalStack has opened its Azure emulator to a free public preview, running Azure services locally and accepting existing ARM, Bicep, and Terraform without rewrites. Its own documentation reports partial operation coverage per service and a consistent pattern: configuration is stored and returned, while enforcement of access restrictions, TLS, and network rules is not implemented. By Steef-Jan Wiggers

articles.title: Google Discloses PageBreak AI Security Agent That Found 500+ XSS Bugs
articles.author: Renato Losio
articles.summary: According to a paper published by Google, its AI-powered security agent has uncovered more than 500 XSS vulnerabilities across its web applications since entering full operation in January. PageBreak uses Gemini models to autonomously investigate potential vulnerabilities, but reports them only after deterministic validators successfully reproduce the exploit against a running application. By Renato Losio
